newsitem.title: USA: Four U.S. oil firms sign Azeri oil deals.
newsitem.headline: Four U.S. oil firms sign Azeri oil deals.

text.p: Azerbaijan's state oil company SOCAR on Friday signed Caspian oil development contracts at the White House with Exxon Corp, Chevron Corp, Mobil Corp and Amoco Corp.
Azeri President Haydar Aliyev Thursday said the deals were worth a total of $8 billion in investment.
Exxon, represented by Exxon Ventures (CIS) president Terry Koonce, signed a production sharing agreement for the Nakhchivan prospect.
Chevron, represented by Chevron Overseas Inc president Richard Matzke, signed an exploration, development and production sharing agreement for the Absheron field, formerly called Tagiev.
Mobil New Exploration and Producing Ventures president Bill Scoggins signed a production sharing agreement for the Oguz offshore field.
And Amoco Euroasia Petroleum Co chairman Charles Pitman signed an agreement for exclusive negotiations on the Inam structure, the White House said.
